title: Support work prepared automatically
persona: A support lead responsible for account access and customer service queues
problem: The lead must read incoming messages, check operational measurements, assemble evidence, decide what needs attention, and repeat that work whenever information changes.
today: Read the messages and operational queue data
Identify the problem and missing context
Compare current conditions with earlier records
Prioritize investigation and record a reason
Revisit the case after new information or a missed follow-up

dataset.target: Next-window breach in a controlled synthetic service queue
dataset.horizon: Two simulation windows; not a customer response guarantee
dataset.business_language: Support messages are expanded into illustrative customer reports. Their controlled outcomes remain explicitly synthetic.

objective: Show background interpretation, model comparison, evidence-linked review, and automatic refresh when the source changes.
invariants: Never present a fixture as a real Jev response
Never present synthetic predictive performance as real customer performance
Require separately approved source scopes before any paid Jev call
Use pinned approved local model files, at most 64 training rows and two CPU threads
A changed source cannot silently inherit an earlier human decision
Unknown compute or provider cost cannot become a zero-cost claim
Preserve running demos, existing review databases, and Olist
No commit, push, deployment, or merge is authorized by this scenario
value_boundary: Illustrative capacity value, not measured labour savings, cash savings, or revenue gain. Provider charges and compute costs are reported separately. Net benefit remains unknown until all required costs are priced.

stack.name: Python
stack.role: Admit the source and check its shape and time

stack.name: Aegra
stack.role: Host runs and bounded scheduled dispatch

stack.name: PostgreSQL
stack.role: Retain source versions, jobs, observations, predictions, and evidence

stack.name: Jev / TypeSafe / OpenRouter
stack.role: Answer a fixed question about the report and return a typed probability or score

stack.name: CatBoost and TabICLv2
stack.role: Compare alternatives using facts alone and facts with Jev interpretation

stack.name: Python / Reflex
stack.role: Display the same packet through a Python frontend

stack.name: SQLite
stack.role: Preserve the demonstration's human decisions independently of the live review database

acceptance: Show the current manual process and business pain
Show original text and admitted structured measurements
Show where Jev runs and how its answer is attached to its source
Compare the baseline, CatBoost, and TabICLv2 on the same time-safe evaluation
Show background jobs and a source change refreshing the packet
Save a labelled test decision and preserve its history
Show the same packet and decision in React and Reflex
Show assumed capacity value alongside measured or unavailable execution costs
Verify the journey against the actual run and retain evidence
